turns.text: Hello, I moved today and need to update the delivery address for my order.

Hello, and I'm sorry to hear about the move. I can help with the delivery address. Please send me your order number (it looks like SC-1234) and the email address the order was placed with, so I can verify it. Then tell me the new address.
The order number is SC-4040 and my email is george.miller.v2@example.com. New address is Str. Exemplu 63, Timisoara.

Thank you, George. I found order SC-4040, but it has already shipped, so I can't change its delivery address. Our policy only allows address changes until an order ships. You can follow the parcel with this tracking link: https://curier.example/track/SC4040. If you need help with the delivery itself, reply here and I can connect you with a colleague.

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.
